charge_port.notes: Tesla's own connector (now NACS / SAE J3400) is used on all Tesla vehicles including the Model 3 (Wikipedia). Canadian and US cars alike.

supercharger_access.notes: Tesla's own Supercharger network, built for this connector (Wikipedia).

wheels.notes: The Driven (2022-04-26): the Long Range's 19 inch sport wheels 'used to be standard' until 18 inch aero returned as standard in April 2022. Applied to this year by assumption; the cars.com 2019 page shows only Standard Range RWD (18 inch), so it does not cover this trim. The Driven names the Long Range only; Mid Range assumed the same. No 18 inch option is stated by any opened source.
